name: WdRevisionsBalloonPrintOrientation
description: Specifies the orientation of revision and comment balloons when they are printed.

constants.name: wdBalloonPrintOrientationAuto
constants.description: Microsoft Word automatically selects the orientation that keeps the zoom factor closest to 100%.

constants.name: wdBalloonPrintOrientationPreserve
constants.description: Word preserves the orientation of the original, uncommented document.

constants.name: wdBalloonPrintOrientationForceLandscape
constants.description: Word forces all sections to be printed in Landscape mode, regardless of original orientation, and prints the revision and comment balloons on the side opposite to the document text.
